title: Smallpox eradication is declared
summary: The World Health Assembly declared smallpox eradicated on 8 May 1980. The achievement followed international surveillance, vaccination and coordinated public-health work.

claims.text: The World Health Assembly declared smallpox eradicated on 8 May 1980. The achievement followed international surveillance, vaccination and coordinated public-health work.
A formal declaration is distinct from the date of the last infection. This milestone concerns smallpox specifically, not the end of infectious disease.
